allowable: Frozen synthetic predicate performance on independently generated challenge population, with counts and uncertainty
Family and domain limitations including failed/indeterminate objectives
Population-shift and feature-sensitivity findings scoped to this challenge and frozen artifacts
comparability: V3 and V4 development results remain historical version-specific findings. Side-by-side descriptive values may be shown only with explicit differences and no paired significance or claimed algorithm uplift. Challenge versus V4 is distribution/task-alignment evidence, not a controlled model improvement estimate. Never pool rows or prevalence. Same frozen model across the two challenge arms supports the declared within-challenge comparison.
prohibited: Proven detection of actual laundering or criminal intent
Natural-population precision/AP inferred from enriched prevalence
Independent evidence after challenge-informed model or threshold revision
Direct algorithm-superiority ranking against V3 using different populations/labels/features/protocols
research_task: Approximation of a synthetic observable review policy, union of twelve causal predicates across structuring, network and agent domains. High target agreement is not independent proof of detecting real money laundering. Real-world effectiveness remains unverified.
